verdict.rationale: Notte's core product is an AI agent you delegate natural-language browsing tasks to ("Describe a task. Watch it happen", "Go to linkedin.com, login..."), and the CLI/MCP let other agents drive it — this is the product's built-in agentic core, not a bolt-on assistant. However, a hands-on community report states a real task (extracting data from hyatt.com) 'completely failed,' directly contradicting the smooth-delegation claims, and the founder himself admits only ~60% success on captcha-gated sites. Missing for 10: independent successful task-completion benchmarks, resolution of the reported failure, and clearer separation of assistant reliability from infra features.
